verses.en: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.pt: Depois disso havia uma festa dos judeus; e Jesus subiu a Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: After these things there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

verses.en: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.
verses.pt: Ora, em Jerusalém, próximo à porta das ovelhas, há um tanque, chamado em hebraico Betesda, o qual tem cinco alpendres.
verses.en_web: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, “Bethesda”, having five porches.
verses.en_bbe: Now in Jerusalem near the sheep-market there is a public bath which in Hebrew is named Beth-zatha. It has five doorways.

verses.en: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.
verses.pt: Nestes jazia grande multidão de enfermos, cegos, mancos e ressicados [esperando o movimento da água.]
verses.en_web: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;
verses.en_bbe: In these doorways there were a great number of people with different diseases: some unable to see, some without the power of walking, some with wasted bodies.

verses.en: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.
verses.pt: [Porquanto um anjo descia em certo tempo ao tanque, e agitava a água; então o primeiro que ali descia, depois do movimento da água, sarava de qualquer enfermidade que tivesse.]
verses.en_web: for an angel went down at certain times into the pool, and stirred up the water. Whoever stepped in first after the stirring of the water was healed of whatever disease he had.

verses.en: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.
verses.pt: Achava-se ali um homem que, havia trinta e oito anos, estava enfermo.
verses.en_web: A certain man was there, who had been sick for thirty-eight years.
verses.en_bbe: One man was there who had been ill for thirty-eight years.

verses.en: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?
verses.pt: Jesus, vendo-o deitado e sabendo que estava assim havia muito tempo, perguntou-lhe: Queres ficar são?
verses.en_web: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be made well?”
verses.en_bbe: When Jesus saw him there on the floor it was clear to him that he had been now a long time in that condition, and so he said to the man, Is it your desire to get well?

verses.en: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhe o enfermo: Senhor, não tenho ninguém que, ao ser agitada a água, me ponha no tanque; assim, enquanto eu vou, desce outro antes de mim.
verses.en_web: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I’m coming, another steps down before me.”
verses.en_bbe: The ill man said in answer, Sir, I have nobody to put me into the bath when the water is moving; and while I am on the way down some other person gets in before me.

verses.en: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.
verses.pt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Levanta-te, toma o teu leito e anda.
verses.en_web: Jesus said to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said to him, Get up, take your bed and go.

verses.en: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.
verses.pt: Imediatamente o homem ficou são; e, tomando o seu leito, começou a andar. Ora, aquele dia era sábado.
verses.en_web: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now it was the Sabbath on that day.
verses.en_bbe: And the man became well straight away, and took up his bed and went. Now that day was the Sabbath.

verses.en: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.
verses.pt: Pelo que disseram os judeus ao que fora curado: Hoje é sábado, e não te é lícito carregar o leito.
verses.en_web: So the Jews said to him who was cured, “It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat.”
verses.en_bbe: So the Jews said to the man who had been made well, It is the Sabbath; and it is against the law for you to take up your bed.

verses.en: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.
verses.pt: Ele, porém, lhes respondeu: Aquele que me curou, esse mesmo me disse: Toma o teu leito e anda.
verses.en_web: He answered them, “He who made me well, the same said to me, ‘Take up your mat, and walk.’”
verses.en_bbe: He said to them, But he who made me well, said to me, Take up your bed and go.

verses.en: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?
verses.pt: Perguntaram-lhe, pois: Quem é o homem que te disse: Toma o teu leito e anda?
verses.en_web: Then they asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Take up your mat, and walk’?”
verses.en_bbe: Then they put to him the question: Who is the man who said to you, Take it up and go?

verses.en: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.
verses.pt: Mas o que fora curado não sabia quem era; porque Jesus se retirara, por haver muita gente naquele lugar.
verses.en_web: But he who was healed didn’t know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.
verses.en_bbe: Now he who had been made well had no knowledge who it was, Jesus having gone away because of the number of people who were in that place.

verses.en: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.
verses.pt: Depois Jesus o encontrou no templo, e disse-lhe: Olha, já estás curado; não peques mais, para que não te suceda coisa pior.
verses.en_web: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple, and said to him, “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.”
verses.en_bbe: After a time Jesus came across him in the Temple and said to him, See, you are well and strong; do no more sin for fear a worse thing comes to you.

verses.en: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.
verses.pt: Retirou-se, então, o homem, e contou aos judeus que era Jesus quem o curara.
verses.en_web: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
verses.en_bbe: The man went away and said to the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.

verses.en: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.
verses.pt: Por isso os judeus perseguiram a Jesus, porque fazia estas coisas no sábado.
verses.en_web: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus, and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.
verses.en_bbe: And for this reason the Jews were turned against Jesus, because he was doing these things on the Sabbath.

verses.en: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.
verses.pt: Mas Jesus lhes respondeu: Meu Pai trabalha até agora, e eu trabalho também.
verses.en_web: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”
verses.en_bbe: But his answer was: My Father is still working even now, and so I am working.

verses.en: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.
verses.pt: Por isso, pois, os judeus ainda mais procuravam matá-lo, porque não só violava o sábado, mas também dizia que Deus era seu próprio Pai, fazendo-se igual a Deus.
verses.en_web: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause the Jews had an even greater desire to put Jesus to death, because not only did he not keep the Sabbath but he said God was his Father, so making himself equal with God.

verses.en: Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.
verses.pt: Disse-lhes, pois, Jesus: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo que o Filho de si mesmo nada pode fazer, senão o que vir o Pai fazer; porque tudo quanto ele faz, o Filho o faz igualmente.
verses.en_web: Jesus therefore answered them, “Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.
verses.en_bbe: So Jesus made answer and said, Truly I say to you, The Son is not able to do anything himself; he is able to do only what he sees the Father doing; whatever the Father does the Son does it in the same way.

verses.en: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.
verses.pt: Porque o Pai ama ao Filho, e mostra-lhe tudo o que ele mesmo faz; e maiores obras do que estas lhe mostrará, para que vos maravilheis.
verses.en_web: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.
verses.en_bbe: For the Father has love for the Son and lets him see everything which he does: and he will let him see greater works than these so that you may be full of wonder.

verses.en: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.
verses.pt: Pois, assim como o Pai levanta os mortos e lhes dá vida, assim também o Filho dá vida a quem ele quer.
verses.en_web: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.
verses.en_bbe: In the same way, as the Father gives life to the dead, even so the Son gives life to those to whom he is pleased to give it.

verses.en: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:
verses.pt: Porque o Pai a niguém julga, mas deu ao Filho todo o julgamento,
verses.en_web: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,
verses.en_bbe: The Father is not the judge of men, but he has given all decisions into the hands of the Son;

verses.en: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.
verses.pt: para que todos honrem o Filho, assim como honram o Pai. Quem não honra o Filho, não honra o Pai que o enviou.
verses.en_web: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.
verses.en_bbe: So that all men may give honour to the Son even as they give honour to the Father. He who gives no honour to the Son gives no honour to the Father who sent him.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.
verses.pt: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo que quem ouve a minha palavra, e crê naquele que me enviou, tem a vida eterna e não entra em juízo, mas já passou da morte para a vida.
verses.en_web: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word, and believes him who sent me, has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.
verses.en_bbe: Truly I say to you, The man whose ears are open to my word and who has faith in him who sent me, has eternal life; he will not be judged, but has come from death into life.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.
verses.pt: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo que vem a hora, e agora é, em que os mortos ouvirão a voz do Filho de Deus, e os que a ouvirem viverão.
verses.en_web: Most certainly, I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and those who hear will live.
verses.en_bbe: Truly I say to you, The time is coming, it has even now come, when the voice of the Son of God will come to the ears of the dead, and those hearing it will have life.

verses.en: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;
verses.pt: Pois assim como o Pai tem vida em si mesmo, assim também deu ao Filho ter vida em si mesmos;
verses.en_web: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.
verses.en_bbe: For even as the Father has life in himself, so he has given to the Son to have life in himself.

verses.en: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.
verses.pt: e deu-lhe autoridade para julgar, porque é o Filho do homem.
verses.en_web: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.
verses.en_bbe: And he has given him authority to be judge because he is the Son of man.

verses.en: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,
verses.pt: Não vos admireis disso, porque vem a hora em que todos os que estão nos sepulcros ouvirão a sua voz e sairão:
verses.en_web: Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes, in which all that are in the tombs will hear his voice,
verses.en_bbe: Do not be surprised at this: for the time is coming when his voice will come to all who are in the place of the dead,

verses.en: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.
verses.pt: os que tiverem feito o bem, para a ressurreição da vida, e os que tiverem praticado o mal, para a ressurreição do juízo.
verses.en_web: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.
verses.en_bbe: And they will come out; those who have done good, into the new life; and those who have done evil, to be judged.

verses.en: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.
verses.pt: Eu não posso de mim mesmo fazer coisa alguma; como ouço, assim julgo; e o meu juízo é justo, porque não procuro a minha vontade, mas a vontade daquele que me enviou.
verses.en_web: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge, and my judgment is righteous; because I don’t seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.
verses.en_bbe: Of myself I am unable to do anything: as the voice comes to me so I give a decision: and my decision is right because I have no desire to do what is pleasing to myself, but only what is pleasing to him who sent me.

verses.en: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.
verses.pt: Se eu der testemunho de mim mesmo, o meu testemunho não é verdadeiro.
verses.en_web: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.
verses.en_bbe: If I gave witness about myself, my witness would not be true.

verses.en: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.
verses.pt: Outro é quem dá testemunho de mim; e sei que o testemunho que ele dá de mim é verdadeiro.
verses.en_web: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.
verses.en_bbe: There is another who gives witness about me and I am certain that the witness he gives about me is true.

verses.en: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.
verses.pt: Vós mandastes mensageiros a João, e ele deu testemunho da verdade;
verses.en_web: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.
verses.en_bbe: You sent to John and he gave true witness.

verses.en: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.
verses.pt: eu, porém, não recebo testemunho de homem; mas digo isto para que sejais salvos.
verses.en_web: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.
verses.en_bbe: But I have no need of a man's witness: I only say these things so that you may have salvation.

verses.en: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.
verses.pt: Ele era a lâmpada que ardia e alumiava; e vós quisestes alegrar-vos por um pouco de tempo com a sua luz.
verses.en_web: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.
verses.en_bbe: He was a burning and shining light, and for a time you were ready to be happy in his light.

verses.en: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.
verses.pt: Mas o testemunho que eu tenho é maior do que o de João; porque as obras que o Pai me deu para realizar, as mesmas obras que faço dão testemunho de mim que o Pai me enviou.
verses.en_web: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John, for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.
verses.en_bbe: But the witness which I have is greater than that of John: the work which the Father has given me to do, the very work which I am now doing, is a witness that the Father has sent me.

verses.en: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.
verses.pt: E o Pai que me enviou, ele mesmo tem dado testemunho de mim. Vós nunca ouvistes a sua voz, nem vistes a sua forma;
verses.en_web: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.
verses.en_bbe: And the Father himself who sent me has given witness about me. Not one of you has ever given ear to his voice; his form you have not seen.

verses.en: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.
verses.pt: e a sua palavra não permanece em vós; porque não credes naquele que ele enviou.
verses.en_web: You don’t have his word living in you; because you don’t believe him whom he sent.
verses.en_bbe: And you have not kept his word in your hearts, because you have not faith in him whom he has sent.

verses.en: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.
verses.pt: Examinais as Escrituras, porque julgais ter nelas a vida eterna; e são elas que dão testemunho de mim;
verses.en_web: “You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.
verses.en_bbe: You make search in the holy Writings, in the belief that through them you get eternal life; and it is those Writings which give witness about me.

verses.en: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.
verses.pt: mas não quereis vir a mim para terdes vida!
verses.en_web: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.
verses.en_bbe: And still you have no desire to come to me so that you may have life.

verses.en: I receive not honour from men.
verses.pt: Eu não recebo glória da parte dos homens;
verses.en_web: I don’t receive glory from men.
verses.en_bbe: I do not take honour from men;

verses.en: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.
verses.pt: mas bem vos conheço, que não tendes em vós o amor de Deus.
verses.en_web: But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.
verses.en_bbe: But I have knowledge of you that you have no love for God in your hearts.

verses.en: I am come in my Father’s name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.
verses.pt: Eu vim em nome de meu Pai, e não me recebeis; se outro vier em seu próprio nome, a esse recebereis.
verses.en_web: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.
verses.en_bbe: I have come in my Father's name, and your hearts are not open to me. If another comes with no other authority but himself, you will give him your approval.

verses.en: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?
verses.pt: Como podeis crer, vós que recebeis glória uns dos outros e não buscais a glória que vem do único Deus?
verses.en_web: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?
verses.en_bbe: How is it possible for you to have faith while you take honour one from another and have no desire for the honour which comes from the only God?

verses.en: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.
verses.pt: Não penseis que eu vos hei de acusar perante o Pai. Há um que vos acusa, Moisés, em quem vós esperais.
verses.en_web: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.
verses.en_bbe: Put out of your minds the thought that I will say things against you to the Father: the one who says things against you is Moses, on whom you put your hopes.

verses.en: For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me: for he wrote of me.
verses.pt: Pois se crêsseis em Moisés, creríeis em mim; porque de mim ele escreveu.
verses.en_web: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.
verses.en_bbe: If you had belief in Moses you would have belief in me; for his writings are about me.

verses.en: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?
verses.pt: Mas, se não credes nos escritos, como crereis nas minhas palavras?
verses.en_web: But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”
verses.en_bbe: If you have no belief in his writings, how will you have belief in my words?
